feeds.title: Children of All Nations Blog
feeds.description: Covers articles related to adoption. Children of All Nations is dedicated to improving the lives of children by constantly reaching out to nations around the world to place children and give humanitarian aid on a global scale.

feeds.title: Adoption Options Blog
feeds.description: International Child Foundation is a highly recommended, licensed Arizona adoption agency, with social workers in Phoenix and Tucson. We are Hague accredited and non-profit and provide adoption services for families throughout the US. Keep up with ABC Infant Adoption and International Child Foundation.

feeds.title: Nightlight Christian Adoptions Blog
feeds.description: MLJ Adoptions is a Hague Accredited international adoption agency! We provide support before, during & after adoption to families in all fifty states. Follow our blog for agency news, international adoption industry topics, and heart-warming stories from our adopted children and their families.

feeds.title: Holt International
feeds.description: Read news and stories about adoption. Also covers articles on topics such as medical care, nutrition, foster care, adoption, family preservation, orphan care, special needs, waiting children and more. Holt International is a world leader in providing services leading to permanent loving families for children around the world. Holt supports a continuum of services to ensure appropriate family care for children separated or at risk of separating from their families.

feeds.title: America World Blog
feeds.description: Covers topics such as adoption education, development, domestic adoption, down syndrome, post adoption, orphan advocacy, travel, HIV+adoption and more. America World Adoption Association is a not-for-profit, registerd 501 (c)(3) and is dedicated to building Christian families through God's design of adoption.

feeds.title: The Adoption Law Firm Blog
feeds.description: The Adoption Law Firm specializes in domestic and international adoptions. Sam McLure, an adoption lawyer in Alabama, discusses Alabama adoption law, encourages the church to care for the fatherless, and shares adoption resources.

feeds.title: Saint Mary International Adoption Blog
feeds.description: Saint Mary International Adoptions provides valuable insight into the international adoption process through its agency's adoption blog.

feeds.title: Tiny Green Elephants
feeds.description: Tiny Green Elephants -- Two young people raising a young family, growing our own food. Life after international adoption.
